items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Quincy asked the guys in the band if they wanted to stay together... Billy Byers made a lot of the arrangements.

ctx.x: And so the show closed when we got to Paris, so Quincy asked the guys in the band if they wanted to stay together. We said sure. So we stayed together. We toured all over Europe. We played the folk parks up in Sweden for the summer and when Nat Cole came over to Europe we did his tour with him. When the Platters came over, the singing group, we did the tour with them. And we just worked over in Paris until that September and we came back. We came back to New York, and when we came back to New York a certain…

Only thing that we found out about the band even though it was a good book and everything, there was not enough individual style for you to associate the band with having a style, you see. That was kind -- a little, kind of little bad, too, you see. A band has got to have a style.
